components.component_archive_state: Original installation receipt preserves upstream URLs and SHA256; complete installed bytes are independently inventoried in native-rs.json. Original compressed component archives were not present in the borrowed cache.

bounds_and_targets.d: BetterC retains -boundscheck=on and uses -checkaction=halt; actual D loops copy checked byte spans without a missing druntime slice-copy dependency. Ordinary codec errors remain explicit statuses; a bounds fault is terminal.
bounds_and_targets.zig: Real wasm32-freestanding and wasm64-freestanding object targets; the matching LLVM 23 WASI closure performs the final link.
bounds_and_targets.tinygo: The current explicit object target uses precise GC and scheduler=none. No blocking scheduler or unqualified goroutine support is implied.
